text: Si on hulii -onon ɓeynguureeji ɗin-, nde resindirɓe ɓen lurrata hakkunde maɓɓe haa hewta ngayngu, hary imminee gorko nunɗuɗo immorɗo e yimɓe gorko on, e gorko nunɗuɗo immorɗo e yimɓe debbo on ; fii no ɓe ñaawira hakkunde maɓɓe no haaniri -foti ɓe seeday maa ɓe wontida- e hoore non ko woŋtidugol ngol ɓuraa yiɗeede. Si ɓen ñaawooɓe ɗiɗo faandike moƴƴingol, Alla Hawrindinay ɓe fottindingol hakkunde resondirɓe ɓen. Pellet, huunde suuɗaaki Alla e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, ko O Annduɗo kala ɓerɗe maɓɓe soomi.
